name: FocusMint 1.3.0

Also in recent FocusMint builds: Earn / Spend / Train records, weekly review, and home actions for study, work, expense, and gym.

name: FocusMint 1.0.8
body:
What's New in This Version

Custom Modes: Personalize your focus sessions with Custom Emoji icons! 
Watch Sync: Your custom modes now sync automatically and permanently to your Apple Watch.
Send Feedback: Reach out to us directly via the new Feedback section in your Profile. 
UI Refinement: Enhanced Dark Mode support and optimized layouts for a smoother experience.
Bug Fixes: Squashed various UI bugs across both iPhone and Watch apps.
Language: Added French supportz!
